QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] The Secret Ingredient
QuestInfo.0: You finally completed the sandwich with help from Simia and the Pi siblings! But it's still missing something. And if you can tell, then Muto will be able to as well.
QuestInfo.1: The Slurpy Fruit from the man-eating Slurpy Tree can give any food that extra kick it needs to achieve perfection. It will be a little dangerous, but go hunt the Slurpy Tree hiding deep inside Slurpy Forest.
QuestInfo.2: You brought back the Slurpy Fruit, the magical seasoning that makes any food better. The slurpy-seasoned sandwich tasted amazing. Surely this is what you need to get Muto on your side!

default.0: Did you gather all the ingredients? Gulla's going to attack soon. We have to hurry.
